# jiuwenbox (vendored)

This directory is a modified copy of the jiuwenbox sandbox engine from
[openJiuwen/agent-security](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/agent-security/tree/main/jiuwenbox),
licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

iCode runs it as a local server that executes shell commands inside a
sandbox. The standard iCode wheel ships the `jiuwenbox` package from
`src/jiuwenbox`; the published iCode metadata does not depend on a separate
jiuwenbox distribution.
